name: Jet Stream
desc: A meandering polar jet drawn as a water-vapor satellite image — a bright fast ribbon separating dry sinking air from moist streaks, buckling into travelling Rossby-wave troughs and ridges that migrate and beat against one another, in grey water-vapor, enhanced color, streamline, thermal or ink looks.
